newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Manila share index fall 1.24 pct on peso concerns.
newsitem.headline: Manila share index fall 1.24 pct on peso concerns.

text.p: The Manila share index dropped 33.49 points, or 1.24 percent, to 2,665.17 points in early Wednesday trade as the market was jarred by renewed market fears of a possible devaluation.

"Fund managers do not want to gamble with an unstable currency and it's affecting sentiment in the equities market. Volatility in interest rates is keeping the market unattractive," said Elline Salvatierra, analyst at Anscor-Hagedorn Securities.
